settings.reaction_setup: 50Cr(28Si, alpha 2p)72Se at 90 MeV, 15UD Pelletron accelerator at IUAC New Delhi; target 550 ug/cm2 50Cr backed with 12 mg/cm2 Au; Indian National Gamma Array (INGA) with 17 Compton-suppressed clover detectors.
settings.angular_definition: DCO:148°×90°矩阵；ADO/Rtheta:(148°或90°)×其余探测器矩阵，见p.3。454.5-keV δ由RDCO-P分析。
settings.angles: Clover detectors at 32 deg, 57 deg, 90 deg, 123 deg, 148 deg; DCO uses 148 deg vs 90 deg; polarimeter uses clovers at 90 deg.
settings.polarization_calibration: 90° clovers; P=Δ/Q。Q由同反应Kr纯跃迁标定，Table II/Fig.6 p.7；a(E)采用Ref.[10]。保留原文Δ，未自行生成P。
settings.curve_evaluation: ANGCOR program for theoretical RDCO vs delta in [-50, +50] with substate width (sigma/j) = 0.3; joint chi2 minimization over experimental RDCO and polarization vs tan^-1(delta).
settings.alignment_details: p. 7: "The width of the substate population (sigma/j) = 0.3 was calculated from the 879.0-, 1338.5-, and 1536.0-keV E1 transitions observed in the present study and found to be consistent with the value mentioned by Rajbanshi et al in Ref. [49]."
